classification.difficultyReason: Interpret total ribbon length as addition of two seventh-metre quantities and recognise 7/7 as one metre; the joined seven-cell diagram supports both steps.

inlines.text: Beca and Ed each have a piece of ribbon.
What is the total length of their ribbon?

spec.description: Seven equal cells, Beca's two cells on the left and Ed's five on the right, with a whole-ribbon question brace above and named group braces below.
spec.mathematics: The two contributions share a denominator of seven.
spec.answerVisibility: The total remains a question mark; no numerical answer is supplied in the question figure.
